observations: LG brand logo and 'Direct Drive 7kg' text visible on the detergent drawer in photo 0.
Model number F1068QDP2 is printed on the drawer in photo 0.
Significant rust is visible on the front panel, specifically along the top seam below the controls and the bottom seam near the floor.
The control panel includes a selection dial and a digital display, which is currently off.
The exterior casing shows signs of wear and dirt.

claims.evidence: Text on the detergent drawer in photo 0 confirms brand, technology, and capacity.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the control board may be defective.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the digital display and indicator lights powered on.

risks.risk: Mechanical failure of the motor, pump, or drum bearings.
risks.proof: A video of the machine successfully completing a high-speed spin cycle.

risks.risk: Water leaks due to the visible rust or perished door seals.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running a wash cycle showing no leaks from the bottom or door.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and running a full wash and spin cycle.
Close-up photo of the rubber door seal and the inside of the drum.
Photo of the rear of the machine to check for further corrosion.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified. Due to the visible rust and lack of proof of operation, it is priced at its worst case as a non-functional unit for parts or requiring major refurbishment.
